page.title.home: VILLA VIEW — A Private Villa in Okinawa | Whole House on the Hill
page.desc.home: A whole-house rental on a hilltop in Nanjo, Okinawa. Four bedrooms, a hall looking out to sea, a covered balcony and a terrace. Sleeps up to 8. Naha Airport is about 40 minutes by car, and a convenience store is 3 minutes on foot.

hero.title:
A whole villa
looking out over the Okinawan sea
hero.lead: A whole-house rental on a hill looking out to sea. Room enough for eight to spread out.
concept.title: Eight people, and still room to breathe
concept.body: The house stands on a hill and measures 153 m². There are four bedrooms, two bathrooms and a toilet on each floor, so when everyone gathers in one place, somewhere else is still free. Through the hall's large windows you look out over the sea by day, and over the lights of the town below at night.
facilities.title: Places to gather, places to be alone
facilities.lead: Six spaces across two floors, each with its own use, so eight people can spend even a rainy day however they like.
facility.room.title: Four Bedrooms
facility.room.desc: Four bedrooms, split between beds and a tatami room with futons, so eight guests never have to argue over where to sleep.
facility.coffee.title: Desk Corner
facility.coffee.desc: A table you can actually sit and work at. Early risers and children doing homework both get a quiet spot.
facility.yoga.title: Ground-Floor Hall
facility.yoga.desc: Wide enough to lay out several mats, whether for yoga, for practice, or for children running around.
facility.bbq.title: Covered Balcony
facility.bbq.desc: The roof overhead means you can still grill in light rain, and the tools are all here.
facility.therapy.title: Sauna Dome Room
facility.therapy.desc: The sauna dome seats one. There is a massage chair in the living room and another in the hall.
facility.minibar.title: Terrace
facility.minibar.desc: The north-facing terrace looks out to sea. Wide enough for all eight, with the breeze coming through.
deals.title: Book directly with us
deals.lead: No agency in between — you talk to us.
deals.lawson.title: LAWSON Nanjo Tsukishiro — 3 min walk
deals.lawson.body: A 24-hour convenience store opened right next door. Just 3 minutes on foot — drinks, snacks, and essentials anytime. Opens April 23, 2026.
deals.direct.title: You talk to us directly
deals.direct.body: Before or after you book, ask us anything. We can also help you plan around your group size and how you want to spend your stay.
dining.title: Local Flavors Around the Villa
dining.lead: The house sits at the quiet end of a residential area, but there are a few soba shops and cafes within a short walk.
exp.title: Beyond the villa
exp.lead: Sacred sites, art, ferries to nearby islands, and quiet beaches — all close by.
access.title: Getting Here
access.detail1: Naha Airport — about 40 min by car
access.detail3: Steps lead from the parking area up to the entrance (lit at night)
